The '''Ceti 597 system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Hollan sector/Legends|Hollan sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ceti 597]].
